photos.summary: Eight golden-brown cookies in two rows of four on parchment-lined sheet pan, fresh from the oven (oven handle visible top of frame). Domed shape, chocolate chips and chunks visible across tops, flaky Maldon salt sprinkled on each. Heritage flour bake — first batch of the BSM Marquis + einkorn experiment, baked 14 min from freezer-chilled scoops.
